The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these because they are semantic/structural text errors, not global blur/noise. The Topology Auditor confirmed clean boundaries, ruling out melting/fusion of the rolls themselves.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'toilet tissue' class geometrically (cylindrical rolls, cardboard core, holder context). The Fine-Grained Classifier confirmed this with high confidence (Top-1: toilet tissue). The deduction from 5.0 is due to the 'printed' nature of the tissue which deviates from the standard 'plain white' expectation, and the nonsensical text which, while not changing the object identity, indicates a generative flaw in surface detail rendering.
